## MALWARE CLASSIFICATION

**Name/Family:** Browser-based Info-stealer (behavioral classification)

**Attribution Method:** Behavioral analysis (signature-confirmed attribution not available from traffic analysis)

**Indicators:**
- Exfiltration of browser fingerprinting data (WebGL, Canvas fingerprints, DOM properties)
- API-based command-and-control beaconing with unique agent ID and token
- Telemetry collection of system and browser capabilities
- Repeated C2 check-ins with browser identification strings

---

## INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

### Command-and-Control Infrastructure

| IOC Type | Value | Port | Protocol | Details |
|----------|-------|------|----------|---------|
| Domain | whitepepper.su | 80, 443 | HTTP/HTTPS | Primary C2 domain; DNS resolves to 153.92.1.49 |
| IP Address | 153.92.1.49 | 80, 443 | HTTP/HTTPS | C2 server; hosted on .su TLD (Russia) |

### C2 Authentication & Identifiers

| Identifier | Value |
|------------|-------|
| Agent ID | 3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C |
| Token | 842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b |

### API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Parameters | Purpose |
|----------|--------|-----------|---------|
| /api/set_agent | GET/POST | id, token, agent, description, act=log | Agent registration and telemetry logging |

### Exfiltrated Data

**Telemetry transmitted to C2 (via POST to `/api/set_agent?...&act=log`):**
- Browser User-Agent strings (Chrome 144.0.0.0, Edge 144.0.0.0)
- WebGL fingerprint data (vendor: Google Inc. AMD, renderer: ANGLE, extensions list)
- Canvas fingerprint data (Base64-encoded PNG signature)
- System platform information (Win32, Windows NT 10.0, x64)
- Hardware concurrency (12 cores)
- Browser capabilities (cookies enabled, DNT: null, vendor: Google Inc.)
- JavaScript navigator properties (appName, appCodeName, product)

### Malicious URLs

| URL | Timestamp (UTC+4) | Method | Purpose |
|-----|-------------------|--------|---------|
| GET /api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e...&description=&agent=Chrome | 2026-01-28T03:05:39 | GET | Initial agent registration (Chrome) |
| POST /api/set_agent?...&agent=Chrome&act=log | 2026-01-28T03:05:40 | POST | Browser fingerprint exfiltration (~8023 bytes payload) |

| POST /api/set_agent?...&agent=Edge&act=log | 2026-01-28T03:05:47 | POST | Browser fingerprint exfiltration (~7975 bytes payload) |
| GET /favicon.ico | 2026-01-28T03:05:40, 03:05:47 | GET | Secondary probe/keepalive |

### File Hashes

No executable payloads or files extracted from this traffic capture. Data transferred was JSON-formatted telemetry, not binary files.

---

## NETWORK ACTIVITY SUMMARY

- **Total beaconing events observed:** 2968 frames to C2 IP across both HTTP (port 80) and HTTPS (port 443)
- **Beaconing frequency:** Agent attempted registration and telemetry logging approximately every 8-10 seconds
- **Data volume to C2:** ~2.5 MB of encrypted (HTTPS) and unencrypted (HTTP) traffic
- **Lateral movement indicators:** SMB2 traffic to domain controller (10.1.21.2:445) present but consistent with normal Windows domain operations (SAMR, LSARPC DCERPC calls)

---

## RECOMMENDATIONS

1. Isolate host 10.1.21.58 immediately to prevent further data exfiltration
2. Block domain whitepepper.su and IP 153.92.1.49 at network perimeter
3. Collect Windows Event Log and PowerShell logs from the victim host to identify initial compromise vector and affected user
4. Scan for similar user-agent patterns and agent ID across network IDS/Suricata logs
5. Review browser history and downloaded files on the affected workstation for malware delivery mechanism
